description: Retrospective application for a detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (248/01B, 248/02B & Unnumbered Site Location Plan, received on 10/06/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.
